description: FlowMatrix-AI org baseline - safe for all repo types

packageRules.description: Route the three PUBLIC engine packages at npmjs. Every other @flowmatrix-ai package (brand, the eight checkout-*, site-generator) is GitHub-Packages-only and 404s on npmjs, which is why the scope-wide npmrc above stays pointed there. GitHub Packages answers 401 to an unauthenticated reader even for these three, so a Renovate lookup without a token finds nothing and proposes no update - the failure mode is silence, not an error. Verified 2026-08-27 by unauthenticated GET: site-components/site-config/site-functions => 200 on npmjs; brand, site-generator and every checkout-* => 404; all thirteen => 401 on GitHub Packages. First in the list so it only sets a registry and leaves the automerge rules below to decide merging.
Conservative automerge: digest/pin updates for language + CI-action managers only. Terraform/Docker/custom (i.e. infra) are excluded so they stay manual. Gated by required ok + gitleaks checks.
Conservative automerge: stable (>=1.0.0) patch updates for language + CI-action managers only. Terraform/Docker/custom excluded; minors/majors stay manual.
